tools.name: rank_campaigns
tools.description: Live clipping campaigns (people paying for Shorts/TikTok/Reels clips of streams) ranked by what a typical approved clip has actually earned, with rate per 1,000 views, cap per clip, budget left and days of budget left. Use for 'which GTA 6 clipping campaign pays most', 'best clipping campaigns right

tools.name: campaign_details
tools.description: Everything known about one clipping campaign: rates per platform, cap, budget left and runway, approved clips, views, typical earnings per clip, and its brief. Pass the campaign id, slug or a heistclips/Content Rewards URL from rank_campaigns.

tools.name: find_moments
tools.description: Finds the moments a Twitch stream's chat exploded (chat speed vs its normal pace, 'clip it' requests, clips viewers already made), and returns timestamps, a suggested clip window, event type, 3-5 hook lines, and music-claim risk (Twitch muted that audio for licensed music). Pass a Twitch or Kick cha

tools.name: live_gta_streams
tools.description: Twitch and Kick channels streaming GTA (GTA VI and GTA V) right now, by viewers, each with a heistclips link to find its moments.

tools.name: request_a_feature
tools.description: Files a feature request on heistclips' public board (heistclips.com/requests) and emails the person who builds it. Use when the user wants heistclips or this connector to do something it does not: a platform, a layout, captions, alerts, a campaign source. Pass their words VERBATIM as `title` (short)

tools.name: list_feature_requests
tools.description: The public heistclips feature-request board: every request with its upvotes and status (requested, building, shipped), most upvoted first. Use before request_a_feature to find an existing request to upvote instead.

tools.name: upvote_feature_request
tools.description: Adds one upvote to a request on the heistclips board, by id from list_feature_requests. One vote per caller; repeat calls do not add more.
